name: progressive-carousel
blurb: Context-based carousel with progress bars and auto-advance controls.
description: A compound component carousel with ProgressSlider managing timing and active slide state. Includes SliderContent, SliderWrapper for slide content, and SliderBtn with progress bars for navigation. Auto-advances on configurable duration or manual button click.
use_when: Building a carousel with visible progress indicators and clickable slide controls.
avoid_when: Simple image galleries—the context-based architecture requires multiple sub-components.
a11y: Progress bar buttons have role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow. Keyboard navigation via button focus. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
